definitions.explanation: A thread-like structure of DNA and proteins found in cells that carries genetic information.

notes:
{染色体|せんしょくたい} refers to the thread-like structures in cell nuclei that carry genetic information.

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{染色|せんしょく}→染色：15817_senshoku⟧ (staining) + ⟦{体|たい}→体：noentry⟧ (body). Named because these structures are easily stained with dyes for microscopic observation.

- Humans have 46 {染色体|せんしょくたい} (23 pairs)
- 22 pairs of ⟦{常染色体|じょうせんしょくたい}→常染色体：noentry⟧: autosomes
- 1 pair of ⟦{性染色体|せいせんしょくたい}→性染色体：noentry⟧: sex chromosomes (XX or XY)
